title: Young Thad F brings back playground vibes and memories with "Recess"
htmlContent: As leaves begin to fall and school bells ring once again all across the States, Young Thad F takes us back to simpler times with his fresh single, "Recess." It's a time capsule, rolled in rhythm and rhyme. He enjoyed school, science was his favorite subject, but his true love was "Recess," that sweet break during the day when most people could take a deep breath and either play or be free. https://open.spotify.com/track/7c6yeXc0lTaizxfP5e8giY?si=f04b1036b44b49df Over a super dope old-school Doggy Charles production, the track glows with that childhood vibe. It's got that bounce and that sense of elementary simplicity, which is what makes hip-hop feel pure. Thad's delivery is at once confident and humble. He knows his sound, and he brings it. There is a refreshing honesty in how he framed his goals at the time to get to the line and to check out some fine dimes. It's youthful, it's playful, and most importantly, it comes from real memory. "Recess" is the sound of reclaiming a feeling. Backed by a thoughtful beat from Doggy Charles and Thad's easygoing reminiscing, the single is a reflection on the idea that sometimes, the best lessons come in between the bells. It's the perfect back-to-school soundtrack for adults who can still recall the kick of the jungle gym. Follow Young Thad F on Instagram
